crossRefs.note: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made the pool, and the conduit, and brought water…
Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and Manasseh his son reigned in his place.
Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem.

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: King of Judah, son of Hezekiah.

translations.web: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
translations.bsb: As for the rest of the acts of Manasseh, along with all his accomplishments and the sin that he committed, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
